skill_name: Explain how to bisect a line segment.
workflow: Bisecting a line segment is the process of dividing it into two equal halves. To bisect a line segment, you need two points on the line segment, A and B. Draw a line perpendicular to the line segment at point A and extend it through point B. This is the line that will represent the bisector of the line segment.
